title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=\frac{1}{1+x^3}$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{3-0}{3}=1$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0$$, $$1$$, $$2$$ and $$3$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$T_3=0.5\left(f{\left(0\right)}+2f{\left(1\right)}+2f{\left(2\right)}+f{\left(3\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$1.129$$.
